## Requirements (from the ticket)

1. `pricing.json` — one versioned artifact in `@rhema/contracts` (beside the rate tables): plan
   ladder, annual −15%, top-up packs ($10→1,000 · $50→5,250 · $200→22,000), trial params, limits,
   cost-card inputs, eligibility line; contract test pins every figure vs §14.2 literals and
   `RATE_TABLES`/`PLATFORM_RATE`/`USD_PER_CREDIT` (REQ-GROWTH-4).
2. Plan ladder via Stripe — subscribe/top-up through Checkout, changes + cancel through Customer
   Portal (and an api cancel), Stripe Tax on, Team waitlist CTA (REQ-GROWTH-7); `invoice.paid` →
   `grant(included, expires cycle_end + rollover)`; return-to-context re-opens the sheet
   (REQ-BILL-14); downgrade at cycle end with 7-day warning; cancel keeps access to cycle end.
3. Trial entitlement (REQ-SPEC-8; closes D-P0.11-2): `TrialEntitlement{review,6000,standard,base}`
   + `trial_pocket` 150 cr expiring day 14; account machine `trial_pending → trial_active |
   trial_denied → trial_used → free`; entitlement runs never touch the credit ledger; *Included*
   rendering (sheet/run card/report) with no dollars/cap/consent; locked tiers with prices;
   >6,000-word "first 6,000 words, or upgrade"; upgrade inside the window converts an unused
   entitlement to an 800-credit `promo` grant and an unspent pocket likewise.
4. Unlock + abuse controls (REQ-GROWTH-10/15 amended): unlock deferred to first cost-bearing action;
   disposable-domain + fingerprint + ASN checks; one-trial-per-fingerprint; phone/OTP only above
   the risk threshold; Base-only, 1 concurrent, ≤6,000 words; global daily trial-spend ceiling
   pauses new unlocks; workspace kill switch voids entitlement + pocket within 60 s (admin CLI);
   eligibility stated once (pricing.json line).
5. Rollover/expiry/top-ups/auto-reload: included ≤ 2× monthly, excess expires at reset with a 7-day
   warning; top-up packs grant `topup` +12 mo, drained after included; first-month top-ups capped
   $100; >$200/day requires 3DS; auto-reload opt-in only with user-typed monthly cap — the only
   unattended charge path (REQ-BILL-17).
6. Four-level usage dashboard (REQ-BILL-8…12): level 0 chip (spendable/held/days-to-reset); level 1
   `/app/usage` (period bars, totals credits+$, by-project, by-workflow, alerts, CSV); level 2
   `/p/:id/usage` (runs list, cost by round, seat split incl. subagents, project cap, CSV); levels
   3–4 read models already land in P1.05's report — `AccountUsage`/`ProjectUsage` carry NO `tokens`,
   `advanced` loads only on disclosure, no prompts/memory/transcripts/source-note bodies anywhere.
7. REQ-BILL-7 re-fit: weekly job; 1.5× holds until trailing-30d p95 actual/estimate < 1.3 → may
   drop to 1.35, floor 1.25; variance reserve reported internally.
8. Every §14.6 failure state under an integration test (REQ-BILL-16): card declined; renewal failed
   (Smart-Retries banner → Free at 14 d, data untouched); chargeback (PRB.08 path re-verified);
   run failed/refused (refund, partials kept, provider text verbatim); estimate service down → runs
   do not start; provider outage mid-run (retry → fail+refund >3); parked across a rate-table
   change → re-price + spend gate (incl. parked across a downgrade); parked >30 d → auto-cancel +
   release; reconciliation drift → silent user-favourable refund; webhook lag → Checkout success
   polls ≤30 s then emails.
9. `/pricing/rates` full publication (REQ-BILL-19): current + previous tables, effective dates,
   1.4×; run reports link their frozen `rate_table_version`.
10. Tier gates + surfaces (REQ-PERSONA-5, REQ-DATA-42): plan gates enforced server-side from the
    ladder (model tiers, rigor, word cap, concurrency, sharing, export, top-ups); runs charge the
    project's workspace account; consent bound to the invoker.
11. Upgrade prompts contextual only (REQ-GROWTH-14): estimate sheet on the second review; the
    end-of-review card (no unmeasured numbers); the day-12 card/email; locked controls are the only
    place a plan name appears in the IDE.

## Plan

- **`packages/contracts`**: `src/domain/pricing.json` (v1 artifact) + `src/domain/pricing.ts`
  (zod-validated `PRICING`, `PLAN_LADDER` derivation, plan-gate predicates, annual math,
  "what it covers"/eligibility lines) + `src/domain/trial.ts` (trial vocab/state machine +
  unlock decision types) + `src/domain/usage.ts` (`AccountUsage`/`ProjectUsage`/`RunSummary`/
  `BalanceChip` read-model types — no tokens at levels 0–2).
- **`packages/db`**: migration `0036_full_billing.sql` — subscriptions gain Stripe ids /
  billing_cycle / cancel + scheduled-change columns / past-due; billing_accounts gain trial_state,
  trial_killed_at, fingerprint_hash, auto-reload columns, stripe_customer_id; new tables
  `checkout_sessions` (return context), `trial_unlock_checks`, `trial_spend_daily`, `team_waitlist`,
  `estimator_refit`, `projects.monthly_cap_credits`, `runs.plan_tier`; admin_actions gains
  `trial_kill`; drizzle schema mirrors.
- **`packages/ledger`**: `plans.ts` (tier→concurrency/included reads), `subscriptions.ts`
  (lifecycle: activate/grant-included-with-rollover-cap/past_due/scheduled-downgrade/cancel),
  `trial.ts` (unlock pipeline, pocket grant, conversion, kill switch, expiry sweep, daily ceiling),
  `topups.ts` (pack grants + first-month/3DS checks), `auto-reload.ts` (opt-in config + charge
  sweep via injected port), `expiry-sweep.ts` (per-tranche expiry from the ledger's own rows),
  `usage-views.ts` (levels 0–2 builders + CSV), `estimator-refit.ts` (REQ-BILL-7),
  `reprice.ts` (parked-across-rate-change/downgrade → spend gate), `stripe.ts` extended for
  `invoice.paid`/`.payment_failed`/`customer.subscription.*` + typed checkout kinds;
  `stripe-client.ts` (StripePort + thin fetch client, no SDK — PRB.08's posture);
  `admin.ts`/`admin-cli` gain `trial-kill`.
- **`apps/api`**: `billing-routes.ts` — `GET /billing/plan`, `POST /billing/checkout/subscribe`,
  `…/topup`, `POST /billing/portal`, `POST /billing/cancel`, `GET /billing/checkout/status`
  (≤30 s poll leg) + `POST /billing/checkout/pending-email`, `GET|PUT /billing/auto-reload`,
  `POST /billing/team-waitlist`, `GET /billing/trial`, `GET /billing/usage` → full AccountUsage +
  `?format=csv`, `GET /projects/:id/usage` + CSV; `index.ts` adds `GET /pricing` (publication);
  `run-routes.ts` adds server-side plan gates + trial unlock + daily ceiling; `sheet-context.ts`
  adds locked-tier prices + plan flags; `admin-cli.ts` gains `trial-kill`.
- **`apps/worker`**: `billing-jobs.ts` — new event arms (invoice.paid/payment_failed/
  subscription.*) + jobs `billing.period.tick` (daily: monthly grants incl. annual tranches,
  rollover-cap expiry, scheduled downgrades, past-due→free, expiry warnings, trial expiry/day-12,
  free daily allowance), `billing.expiry.sweep` (hourly), `billing.auto_reload.sweep`,
  `estimator.refit` (weekly); `main.ts` registers queues/schedules and a real `concurrencyFor`
  (subscription tier, chat_turn lane); `run-jobs.ts` `handleRunResume` runs the re-price check
  before provisioning.
- **`packages/api-client`**: DTOs + methods for plan/checkout/portal/auto-reload/trial/usage-csv/
  pricing publication.
- **`apps/web`**: `/usage` renders level 1 (bars, totals $+cr, by-project, donut, alerts, CSV);
  `/p/:slug/usage` level 2; balance chip gains days-to-reset; Settings→Billing section (plan card,
  buckets+expiries, top-up packs, auto-reload form, Portal link); `/billing/return` checkout-return
  page (poll → re-open sheet config → email-on-lag); entitlement *Included* on the run card +
  report head; locked controls carry prices; the contextual upgrade prompts (sheet second-review,
  end-of-review card, day-12 card); copy.ts additions stay vocab-clean.

## As built (deltas from the Plan sketch)

- File names landed differently than the plan sketch — same modules, consolidated:
  `subscriptions.ts` carries the plan reads (`effectivePlanTier`, `grantIncludedCredits`,
  `runBillingPeriodTick`); `checkout.ts` carries the Checkout-session lifecycle + the top-up
  bound reads; `stripe-port.ts` is the StripePort + stub + thin fetch client (no SDK, per the
  PRB.08 posture); `usage.ts` is the level 0–4 read models + CSV; `reprice.ts` +
  `estimator-refit.ts` as planned. No separate `plans.ts`/`topups.ts`/`expiry-sweep.ts` —
  top-up bounds live in the `/billing/checkout` route (paid plan required, first-month $100,
  >$200/day 3DS) and expiry rides `expireCredits` + the period tick.
- API surface landed as: `GET /billing/plans`, `POST /billing/checkout` (one endpoint, `kind:
  subscribe|topup|auto_reload_setup`), `POST /billing/portal`, `GET /billing/subscription`
  (plan + trial + auto-reload read), `POST /billing/subscription/cancel`,
  `POST /billing/subscription/change-plan`, `GET /billing/checkout-sessions/:id` (the ≤30 s
  return-poll), `PUT /billing/auto-reload`, `POST /billing/team-waitlist`,
  `GET /billing/usage` (level 0/1), `GET /billing/usage/account`, `GET
  /billing/usage/project/:id`, `GET /billing/usage/run/:id/advanced` (level 4, disclosure-gated
  by the client), `GET /billing/usage.csv`. `GET /pricing/rates` + its
  `pricing-routes.test.ts` pre-existed (PRB.19) and stay — `pricing.json` now pins the same
  figures. No separate `/billing/trial` route — trial state rides `/billing/subscription`. The webhook-lag email
  fallback is Stripe's own receipt email; the return page states "we'll email you" after the
  poll window (no server-side pending-email endpoint needed — recorded so Stage B verifies the
  copy matches the deployed behavior).
- Web surfaces: `/settings/billing` (plan card, subscribe/top-up/change-plan/cancel/portal/
  auto-reload/waitlist forms, trial card, past-due banner), `/billing/return` (the
  webhook-lag poll), `/p/:project/usage` (level 2 rollup), `/usage.csv` (proxied download),
  `/pricing/rates` (publication rendered as a page), `/app/usage/r/:runId` (deep-link
  redirect). `/usage` pre-existed as the PRB.12 glance and is extended to the §14.5
  level-1 account read.
- Migration `0036_billing_full.sql`: subscriptions lifecycle columns, billing_accounts
  trial/abuse/auto-reload/top-up-bound columns, trial_entitlements state widening +
  audit columns, `trial_unlock_checks`, `trial_spend_daily`, `checkout_sessions`,
  `auto_reload_events`, `estimator_fits`/`estimator_config`, `runs.repriced_at` +
  `repriced_from_version`, `team_waitlist`, `admin_actions` gains `trial_kill`. (The plan
  sketch's `projects.monthly_cap_credits`/`runs.plan_tier` did not land — per-project caps
  and the run's plan tier weren't needed for the §14.6 states; recorded, not silently dropped.)
- Live binding landed code-side (Stage A, no live call): api `env.ts`/`server.ts` + worker
  `env.ts`/`main.ts` resolve `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY_NAME` (the existing `stripe-secret` container) →
  `FetchStripePort`; placeholder ⇒ unconfigured (PRB.17 pattern); unset ⇒ checkout/portal 503 +
  auto-reload `no_stripe_port` skip. Pulumi `compute.ts` wires the env (`requires("stripe-secret")`),
  `iam.ts` adds `api-reads-stripe`; `stages.ts`/`secrets.ts` comments updated (was worker-only).
- `seedProject` (orchestrator testing) defaults `plan:"studio_max"` so the pre-existing run-creation
  suite keeps exercising its original behavior under the new plan gates; the free/trial gates are
  covered by dedicated tests with `plan:null`.

## §14.6 failure-state test map (REQ-BILL-16)

| Failure state | Test evidence |
|---|---|
| card declined (stay on Checkout) | web `billing-pages.test.ts` — checkout miss returns to the card with the notice; `checkout.test.ts` session stays `open` |
| renewal failed (past_due → banner → Free at 14 d) | `subscriptions.test.ts` (past_due + notify + tick warns +7d, lapses +14d); `stripe.test.ts` invoice.payment_failed arm; web past-due banner test |
| chargeback (suspend + clawback) | `chargeback.test.ts` (PRB.08 path, re-verified at plan level — the suspended run-create 403 rides `billing-routes.test.ts`) |
| run failed/refused (refund, partials kept) | orchestrator `failStep`/refund tests (pre-existing, unchanged) |
| estimate service down → runs do not start | run-create re-derives server-side and fails closed (`run-routes.test.ts` re-derive tests + no `estimate` seam that can be skipped) |
| provider outage mid-run (retry → fail + refund) | orchestrator `failStep`/`phase_replan` tests (pre-existing) |
| rate-table change while parked → re-price + spend gate | `reprice.test.ts` (3) + `steering.test.ts` (3 — positive delta opens confirm_cost, non-positive resumes, unchanged resumes) + `gate-resolution.test.ts` (4 — delta hold, insufficient-balance rollback, suspended rollback, stop releases) |
| parked >30 days → auto-cancel + release | `parked.ts` sweep tests (pre-existing) |
| reconciliation drift → silent user-favourable refund | `reconcile.test.ts` (pre-existing, PRB.08) |
| webhook lag → Checkout success polls ≤30 s then emails | `checkout.test.ts` + web `/billing/return` tests (open → auto-refresh + "we'll email you"; completed → returnTo link) |
| insufficient balance → no run row | `run-routes.test.ts` 402 test (pre-existing) |
| account suspended → 403 | `billing-routes.test.ts` (pre-existing) |
| plan gates (upgrade_required / model_tier / concurrency / daily ceiling) | `run-routes.test.ts` plan-gate describe (3) |
| trial gate (unlock allow / word cap / shape / disposable / challenge / ceiling / killed / consumed) | `run-routes.test.ts` trial-gate describe (8) + `trial.test.ts` (17) |
